raw_text: Recurrent peritoneal implant tumor sequencing: TP53 NM_000546:exon8:c.818G>A:p.R273H somatic pathogenic variant (VAF about 63%); CCNE1 high-level amplification (estimated copy number 9); MYC gain; HRD negative; no pathogenic or likely pathogenic BRCA1/2 variant; germline BRCA1 VUS only; MSI stable; TMB low. Pathology/IHC biomarkers: FRalpha heterogeneous on current biopsy, archived block high; PD-L1 CPS 18; HER2 2+ heterogeneous with rare focal 3+ area, ISH non-amplified.
summary: Recurrent peritoneal implant tumor sequencing: TP53 pathogenic mutation, CCNE1 high-level amplification, MYC gain, HRD negative, no pathogenic BRCA1/2 variant, BRCA1 VUS only, MSI stable, TMB low; FRalpha/PD-L1/HER2 in pathology.
